finding: During S4 R1-to-R2 avoidance both trackers interpreted a stationary obstacle reported by the driver as moving laterally. Local extrapolated collision caused the full brake; the route moving-object cap also started deceleration.
new_logic_observed: candidate_vx/vy and prediction_confirmed published by local tracker
traffic_speed_cap_kmh published in all 112 route outputs

local_motion.mechanism: Two consecutive same-direction fits exceeded confirmation threshold; a previously confirmed velocity can be retained up to 0.4 s while fit is unreliable.

diagnostic_counterfactual.purpose: Isolate velocity extrapolation; not a proposal to ignore real moving obstacles.

previous_relevant_bag: semi_leo_2026-10-21-21-47-29.bag also shows dynamic-triggered local BLOCKED and route YIELD.
limits: Static nature is reported by the driver; no simulator object ground-truth topic was recorded.
The cause of the lateral measurement drift itself requires separate sensor/pose analysis; changing visible surfaces and ego-motion compensation are possible contributors.

upstream_pose_check.conclusion: This timing mismatch does not explain the observed approximately 0.9 m lateral drift; upstream measurement artifact is not yet isolated.

upstream_scan_check.hypothesis: Uncompensated motion within a rotating scan could contribute to apparent translation.
